description.value: Gia Foods is a Canadian wholesale importer and distributor of premium imported groceries, operating since 2004 from a warehouse facility at 8288 North Fraser Way. Their catalogue spans basmati rice in bulk sizes, lentils, pure ghee, frozen flatbreads, Portuguese tarts, spices, and snacks, serving households, retailers, and foodservice professionals across Canada. The North Fraser Way location is an industrial-area warehouse rather than a conventional retail storefront, so the practical accessibility for a drop-in cyclist is uncertain.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Gia Foods is an active wholesale food importer and distributor operating since 2004, with a broad catalogue (rice, lentils, spices, ghee, frozen foods, snacks) and contact hours. The OSM toll-free phone (+1-800-503-7423) matches the website contact page exactly. No cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, and the industrial-area warehouse address (North Fraser Way) with wholesale-only positioning makes walk-in retail access for individual customers unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM tag is shop=wholesale; this is a wholesale food distributor in an industrial area, not a retail grocery — walk-in access for individual customers is not confirmed by the website.
Website lists two local phone numbers not in OSM: 604-304-8327 (contact page) and 604-244-0993 (footer); only the toll-free +1-800-503-7423 matches OSM.
OSM community field lists 'Richmond' but 8288 North Fraser Way is likely within Burnaby — jurisdiction should be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business with a live website and confirmed contact details. Wholesale nature and industrial location are flagged as concerns but are not grounds for exclusion under directory rules.
